content.short: Host.tg is a Telegram event-management app for creating, organizing, and managing events from chat.
content.description: Host.tg brings event management into Telegram. Users can create and manage events directly through the Telegram experience, making it useful for communities that coordinate meetups, campaigns, or group activities without moving to a separate event platform. Start managing events for free with Host™ on Telegram. Explore both online and offline events, effortlessly sell tickets, with crypto payment options available.
